Name: TungTungSahur
Author: atudota
Description:
[size=4][b]Tung Tung Sahur — Now in Stardew Valley![/b]
[/size]A suspicious wooden figure carrying a club has appeared near the town fountain. Get too close, and you’ll hear that familiar sound… followed by a very good reason to run.

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]An animated Sahur enemy with custom audio and [b]180 HP[/b].[/*]
[*]Detects players within [b]7 tiles[/b] of his home.[/*]
[*]Pursues you within a [b]40-tile radius of his home[/b]. Leave his territory or enter another location, and he’ll stop chasing and return.[/*]
[*]Drops [b]100 Wood[/b] when defeated. A new Sahur appears the next in-game day.[/*]
[*]A craftable [b]Sahur Club[/b]: costs [b]999 Wood[/b], deals [b]25–40 damage[/b], and works against regular monsters. The recipe unlocks automatically.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700]Requirements[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.x[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=posts&u2PqOG96mP=z1KwuhUc][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/url][/*]
[*][b]Single-player only[/b][/*]
[/list]No additional mods are required. Audio is included inside the mod’s DLL.
[b]Installation[/b]
Extract the
[code]TungTungSahur[/code]folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code], then launch the game through SMAPI.
When updating, completely replace the previous mod folder.
[b]Configuration[/b]
Edit
[code]config.json[/code]to adjust health, damage, volume, character size, spawn location, detection radius, and pursuit radius. Restart the game after changing these settings.
[b]SMAPI Console Commands[/b]
[list]
[*][code]sahur_weapon[/code]— Receive a free Sahur Club for testing.[/*]
[*][code]sahur_spawn[/code]— Respawn Sahur at his home.[/*]
[*][code]sahur_sethome[/code]— Set his home to your current position.[/*]
[*][code]sahur_remove[/code]— Remove Sahur and stop his audio.[/*]
[/list][b]other mods:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55228][b]Stardew Cartel[/b][/url]

[b]Known Limitations[/b]
Sahur passes through obstacles and is drawn over world objects. Weapon hit detection is simplified. Multiplayer is not supported.
Version 1.2.0 builds successfully and has passed automated checks, but still needs in-game testing.
[i]He heard you. Tung tung tung…[/i]
